Schafer Cullen Capital Management Inc increased its stake in Vermilion Energy Inc. (VET) by 6.38% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. The hedge fund held 2.01 million shares of the oil & gas production company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $72.85 million, up from 1.89M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Schafer Cullen Capital Management Inc who had been investing in Vermilion Energy Inc. for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $4.44B market cap company. Nj State Employees Deferred Compensation Plan decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 6.35% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC.
